moments.text: Black-and-white infrared view down on the sea, purple crosshair and north marker. A surfaced submarine sits near the crosshair as the sensor follows it.
A small bright dot enters at the left edge, just above the lower-left redaction box, and moves right along the bottom of the frame.
The sensor pans right after the dot and the submarine leaves at the upper left; the dot then drifts left and up toward the crosshair.
A second bright dot enters at the lower right, crosses up and to the left below the first, and leaves at the left edge.
The first dot turns and moves right across the frame, leaving at the right edge.
A bright dot enters at the left edge, above centre, and moves right to just above the crosshair.
The sensor keeps the dot close to the crosshair, at times hidden behind it. The picture blinks dark briefly three times.
The dot slides down to the lower right; the picture flickers and the view zooms out to a wide, smooth grey sea.
In the wide view the submarine is a tiny shape, first right of the crosshair, then left of it.
After a brief flicker the view zooms back in on the submarine, now lying left to right just below the crosshair.
A small bright dot appears near the right edge, below centre, and moves up and left to the submarine.
The view pans left; the submarine slides right and leaves at the right edge, leaving open sea.
A small bright dot appears upper right of the crosshair, hangs just to its right for several seconds, then slides onto it.
Two small bright dots sit in the upper left of the frame, drifting slowly right.
The view briefly zooms out wide, the submarine a small shape below-right of the crosshair, then zooms back in on it.
The view pans left and the submarine slides off the right edge; near 4:39 it slides back in and settles on the crosshair.

notes: Many brief dark/white flickers (1-10 frames) at zoom changes. Dots are a few pixels wide; official 4:09-4:37 object not confirmed in the frames.
